entries.speaker: Huafei
entries.text: RongMoMo, look closely. This little thing is the contestant people keep fussing over?

entries.speaker: Huafei
entries.text: Mm. Bright hair, loud clothes, common manners. How tiresome.

entries.speaker: CupcakKe
entries.text: Oh brother, here comes Princess Judgmental.

entries.speaker: Huafei
entries.text: Princess? How vulgar. If you must compare me to anything, compare me to the moon above the stagnant pond. Untouchable. Refined. Worshipped from a distance.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Why are all the mean people in this school so poetic?

entries.speaker: Huafei
entries.text: Because unlike you, I do not throw myself at the public like a discount flyer. Tell me, why do people praise such noisy little toys?

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: Because I'm an idol, not a museum exhibit.

entries.speaker: Huafei
entries.text: Hm. And yet an idol without dignity is only a clown with followers.

entries.speaker: Miku
entries.text: You know what? Keep insulting me. I'm still getting on that stage.

entries.speaker: Huafei
entries.text: Good. Then try to stand before me without shrinking.

entries.speaker: Huafei
entries.text: Then ascend the stage, and reign until your last breath.
